newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Mobil Plastics Europe in branch sales talks.
newsitem.headline: Mobil Plastics Europe in branch sales talks.

text.p: Mobil Plastics Europe, a wholly-owned unit of the Mobil Chemical Company, has opened talks with Illinois Tool Works Inc about the sale of its stretchable polyethylene film operations.

The sale, due to be concluded in the second quarter of this year, would mean the end of Mobil's stretchable films operations following the 1995 sale of its five other stretchable films businesses, the Luxembourg-based Mobil Chemicals said in a statement.
Stretchable polyethylene films are mostly used for packaging food and adhesive plasters.
The firm gave no indication of the anticipated sale price, but said it would not affect the 1,000 people employed in the stretchable film operation.
Illinois Tools Works Inc is an international manufacturer of high technology industrial systems components. It has 365 plants in 34 countries and employs 24,400 people.
